noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

syntax.description:
The DSL keyword (or other syntax) for this option or specification value. If unspecified, the field name is used,
with camel case mapped to space-separated words.

suppress.description:
If true, this field isn't emitted as part of DSL printing. This represents something calculated from declared
fields or other state.

suffix.description: Boolean fields are usually printed as prefixes, but this puts them in suffix position instead.

ident.description: String values are usually printed as literal strings, but this prints them as identifiers instead.

flag.description: If true, any non-null value in this field causes the keyword to be printed and the value itself is ignored.

expr.description:
If true, the value is assumed to be an expression (string) and printed without additional quoting as would be
done for a normal literal.

title: Special annotations for DSL printing of metadata structure (types and default UI).
name: Ann.Dsl
